answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 13871 Country: India Title: Assalam O Alaikum, What is the ruling of Shariah about using illegal water and electricity in a masjid. Illegal means theft of electricity and water without paying for it. Question: Assalam O Alaikum, What is the ruling of Shariah about using illegal water and electricity in a masjid. Illegal means theft of electricity and water without paying for it. Answer ID: 13871 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 958/958=M/1430) It is unlawful to use water and electricity illegally in mosques. Theft is sinful act whether committed in mosque or outside, rather committing theft in a holy place like mosque is more heinous. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
